map.toScene: scene x = (x - origin[0]) * unitsPerPx, scene z = (y - origin[1]) * unitsPerPx, scene y = h * heightScale; map x runs east and map y south, h is a fraction of the peak
map.angles: map angles in degrees, north 0 and clockwise (east 90, south 180, west 270); an asset whose front faces `facing` takes rotation.y = (180 - facing) degrees

heightmap.sample: pixel (i, j) holds h at map point x = i, y = j; row 0 is the north edge

mesh.units: metres about the map origin, X east, Y up, Z south; scale by unitsPerMetre

COLOR_0.holds: the painted ground colour, blended from four classes

COLOR_1.holds: the four ground textures' weights in R, G, B, A, summing to 1
COLOR_1.notes: gravel is 1 within 6 px of every road's centreline (cobbles in the village, gravel outside) and on the quay apron and the square, and also takes the bare rock of the cliffs and crags; earth is the worn verges out to 12 px, the stream's bed (kept under the bridge and at the watermill) and the pond; sand is the beach and the sea floor

roads.units: x, y map px; h a fraction of the peak; s the plan distance in px from the first row; t = s / lengthPx
roads.notes: every row is 1 px apart; h is the road surface after relaxation, camber not included. The ring starts at the quay (365, 505) and runs in the document's order, with the stone bridge's hump (0.8 m at (398, 524), easing out over 12 px either side); each spur's first row lies on the ring

stream.notes: h is the water surface, not the bed: 0.25 m over the bed, never rising downstream, level with the pond from where it backs up the stream to the watermill's dam

pond.notes: the watermill GLB carries the pond's water surface

deviations: The coast's softness turns from shore to cliff over 0.06 rad either side of 0.2 and 2.4 rad instead of in one step, which notched the coastline.
The mill pond has a 3 px bank either side of its 16 px radius instead of a vertical wall.

The bailey keeps its flat top to 28 px and falls to the knoll's slope over a 6 px bank outside it; the knoll cliff's line turns over 1 px either side and its cap's arc over 3 px, instead of in one step.
Bare rock is sculpted: gullies up to heightmap.CRAG_DEPTH of the peak are carved into steep or high ground clear of the roads, the summit and the bailey; nothing rises above the specification.
Each spur leaves the ring at the ring's relaxed height and eases into its own profile over 20 px.
The roads leave the stream's channel open under the bridge and the watermill, and never fill the sea or the pond.
